questions.answer: The orders service (process java[53655], serving 127.0.0.1:40541) read billing.crt, via iormesh.workload.scenarios.ServiceNode#readCert.
The inventory service (127.0.0.1:39719) served two requests: POST /inventory/reserve and GET /inventory/stock/widget (both http, returning 200).

While serving POST /billing/charge, the billing service wrote its invoice record `/tmp/TestMicroservices620604276/002/billing.d/invoice-42.json` (via DataStore#save), making it appear atomically by: openat of `invoice-42.json.tmp` (O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC), a newfstat on it, write of 32 bytes, close, then rename of `invoice-42.json.tmp` to `invoice-42.json` — i.e. the write-to-temp-then-rename pattern. (The file was statx'd and unlinked later on the main thread at retire, not while serving.)
